Name: Rokunai's Herbs and Recipes
Author: rokunai
Description:
This mod adds 3 crops (Butterfly Pea, Lemongrass, and Roselle Fruit) and the items listed below:

[list]
[*]Butterfly Pea and Lemongrass Tea (Put Butterfly Pea in the Keg -requires 1 Lemongrass)
[*]Butterfly Pea Cola[b] *requires hadiwrites42's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5173]Artisanal Soda Makers[/url][/b]
[*]Butterfly Pea Lemonade[b] *requires either PPJA [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5173][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1671]More Trees[/url][/b][b] or my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15116]Common Food Ingredients[/url] mod[/b]
[*]Butterfly Pea Milk Boba[b] *requires either PPJA [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1598]Fruits and Veggies[/url] or my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15116]Common Food Ingredients[/url] mod[/b]
[*]Butterfly Pea Shaved Ice[b][b] *requires hadiwrites42's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5173][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5388]Shaved Ice & Frozen Treats[b] [/b][/url][/b][b]or[b] my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15116]Common Food Ingredients[/url] mod[/b][/b][/b]
[*]Butterfly Pea Soda[b] *requires hadiwrites42's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5173]Artisanal Soda Makers[b] [/b][/url][b]or my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15116]Common Food Ingredients[/url] mod[/b][/b]
[*]Butterfly Pea Syrup[b] *requires hadiwrites42's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5173]Artisanal Soda Makers[/url][/b]
[*]Lemongrass Oil (Put 10 Lemongrass in Oil Maker)
[*]Roselle and Ginger Tea (Put Roselle Fruit in the Keg -requires 1 Ginger)
[*]Roselle Milk Boba[b] *requires either PPJA [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1598]Fruits and Veggies[/url] or my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15116]Common Food Ingredients[/url] mod[/b]
[*]Roselle Orange Juice
[*]Roselle Shaved Ice[b][b] *requires hadiwrites42's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5173][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5388]Shaved Ice & Frozen Treats[b] [/b][/url][/b][b]or[b] my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15116]Common Food Ingredients[/url] mod[/b][/b][/b]
[*]Roselle Soda[b] *requires hadiwrites42's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5173]Artisanal Soda Makers[b] [/b][/url][b]or my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15116]Common Food Ingredients[/url] mod[/b][/b]
[*]Roselle Syrup[b] *requires hadiwrites42's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5173]Artisanal Soda Makers[/url][/b]
[/list]
[b]Note: soda and shaved ice are cooking items when you only have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15116]Common Food Ingredients[/url][/b][b]. When you don't have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5173]Artisanal Soda Makers[/url] and [/b] [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5388]Shaved Ice & Frozen Treats[/url][/b][b], SMAPI will warn as the rules are ignored, and it's not an error.
[/b]
All entities (items and crops) in this mod are compatible with the same name entities in other mods.
This mod is [b]open to recipe/machine/shop use[/b], feel free to use for your mod. ([b]Note: don't copy-paste the items into your mod.[/b] JA items could be referenced from outside the mod.)
All crops and objects in this mod have translation keys.
The mod is accepting i18n translation files without the author's permission.

[line]
[b][b]///// [/b]Please check the below if the mod doesn't work! /////[/b]
(There's a large possibility that I made mistakes, but sometimes the error is caused by the condition of the users)

[b]Is all folders placed in the Stardew Valley\Mods folder?[/b]
This mod has no replaceable options.
Don't remove the [JA] or [PFM] folders or the folders that were placed in them. 

[b]Is the latest version of the required (not optional) mods installed?[/b]
This mod is a content pack.
The function of the mod is completely dependent on the frameworks, which you can see in the requirements section.
Not installing the required mods or forgetting to update them may cause errors.

[b]Is the [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log [/url]parser pointing out the error caused by this mod? 
[/b]The SMAPI log parser gives you information about the error that happened in your modded game.
It tells you what mod and why it is causing the error, and you may find the problem in your condition sometimes.
If you find the error is caused by the mod (it means it's my mistake), please send me the link to your error log.
It's helpful for mod authors to fix their problems.
